title: Refuse stale mobile worker generation
description: An active private worker is selected using an obsolete generation and a nonempty draft. Its input must remain disabled.

open-stale.intent: Open an obsolete generation of an otherwise live worker.

stale-error.intent: Show the gateway refusal for the stale task generation.

read-only.intent: Keep the prefilled obsolete instruction from controlling the live worker.

capture.intent: Record the stale-target refusal and disabled input controls.

verify.intent: Prove the live worker received no command and the draft made no file.
